international_aviation.headline: 英國法院裁定新創航空 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序
international_aviation.summary: 根據官方紀錄，英國破產與公司法院（Insolvency and Companies Court）已裁定計畫營運空中巴士（Airbus）A380 客機的新創航空公司 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序。英國官方公報《The Gazette》於 2026 年 11 月 12 日發布正式公告，證實法院已於 11 月 4 日頒布「清算令」（Winding-Up Order），此項裁決源自 2026 年 5 月向英國法院提出的清算申請。
international_aviation.headline_en: UK court orders compulsory liquidation for A380 startup Global Airlines
international_aviation.summary_en: the Insolvency and Companies Court in the United Kingdom has ordered Airbus A380 startup Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation. The Official Public Record, The Gazette, published a formal notice on November 12, 2026, confirming that the court granted a Winding-Up Order on November 4, 2026. This ruling followed a Petition to Wind Up originally filed with the UK court in May 2026.

international_aviation.headline: 航管通訊中斷：美國聯邦航空總署下令全美航班地面停飛
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於2026年11月13日星期五美東時間下午4時前不久下令全美地面停飛，原因是通訊中斷影響全美每一座航路交通管制中心。所有出發航班暫停至另行通知，FAA其後建議機組人員預期全美各機場將出現空中等待。美國運輸部長尚恩·達菲表示，問題是影響所有航路交通管制中心的通訊問題，FAA技術人員正在調查中；他的初步聲明未指明是哪一個系統故障，也未提供出發航班恢復的時間。FAA表示，此舉出於高度謹慎，空中航班獲准繼續飛行，國際航班將逐案處理，每一架航班均已掌握。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA orders nationwide ground stop as communications outage hits air traffic control centers
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop shortly before 4 p.m. Eastern time on Friday, November 13, 2026, after a communications outage affected every Air Route Traffic Control Center in the United States. All departures were suspended until further notice, and the FAA later advised crews to expect airborne holding nationwide. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the problem as "a communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers" and said FAA technicians were investigating; his initial statement did not identify which system had failed or say when departures would resume. The FAA confirmed the ground stop was implemented "out of an abundance of caution", saying: "There has been a temporary telecommunications outage - out of an abundance of caution all flights have been halted. Every flight has been accounted for and international flights will be handled on a case by case basis."

international_aviation.headline: 白宮籲國會批准301億美元升級美國航空基建與航管設施
international_aviation.summary: 白宮正敦促國會批准額外301億美元美國航空基礎設施升級經費。據路透社報導，運輸部長達菲（Sean Duffy）與預算主任沃特（Russell Vought）正推動在民主黨明年1月接掌國會前完成立法。兩人11月13日致函國會領袖，要求迅速批准這筆投資；民主黨預定2027年1月3日接掌國會，政府希望在共和黨掌控國會的最後幾週內推進提案，不過法案前景仍不明朗，國會領導層更替也不必然意味經費會遭否決。
international_aviation.headline_en: White House urges Congress to approve $30.1 billion for US aviation infrastructure and air traffic upgrades
international_aviation.summary_en: The White House is urging Congress to approve an additional $30.1 billion for US aviation infrastructure upgrades. Reuters reports that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and budget director Russell Vought are pushing for action before Democrats take control of Congress in January. In a November 13 letter to congressional leaders, Duffy and Vought requested swift approval of the investment, saying: "This investment is critical to complete the modernization of our national airspace." With Democrats preparing to assume control of Congress on January 3, 2027, the administration is seeking to advance the proposal during the remaining weeks of Republican control, although the legislation's prospects remain uncertain.
